# Route 2 Migrate

> Route 2 Migrate is a Canadian immigration consultancy led by Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC) Riffat H. Mohaimen (CICC licence R710078). The firm provides Canadian immigration consulting and related visa application support to clients in Canada, Bangladesh, and internationally.

Canonical website: https://www.route2migrate.ca/
Organization: RMohaimen Immigration Services, operating as Route 2 Migrate.
Regulator: College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (CICC).
Professional membership: Canadian Association of Professional Immigration Consultants (CAPIC).
Email: contact@rmigrate.ca
Canada office: 123 Parkway Forest Dr, Apt./Suite/Unit #805, North York, ON M2J 0G1, Canada.
Bangladesh office: 93 Shah Makhdum Avenue, Flat A2, Sector 12, Uttara, Dhaka 1230, Bangladesh.
Canada phone: +1 (437) 332-8242.
Bangladesh phones: +880 1896 060701, +880 1896 060702, +880 1896 060703.

## About the Consultant

Riffat H. Mohaimen is an RCIC licensed by the CICC (R710078) and a CAPIC member. Her profile describes a Master's degree from Durham University, a Graduate Diploma in Canadian Immigration Law, experience at the US Embassy/Consulate in Dhaka and Canadian immigration law firms, and authorization to represent clients before Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC).

For current credentials and professional background, see [About](https://www.route2migrate.ca/about). Verify a consultant's current licence status with the [CICC public register](https://college-ic.ca/protecting-the-public/find-an-immigration-consultant).

## Services

Route 2 Migrate describes consulting and application support for Canadian immigration pathways, including Express Entry, Provincial Nominee Programs (PNP), study permits, work permits, spousal open work permits, family sponsorship, Super Visas, visitor visas, and business immigration. Other services include immigration consultations, application reviews, Educational Credential Assessment (ECA) guidance, CELPIP/CAEL test preparation, and Schengen visa application support. The Services page also describes USA visitor/student visa and UK Standard Visitor visa support.

These are service descriptions, not a determination that a person qualifies for a program or visa. Eligibility and government requirements depend on the applicant's circumstances and can change.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Who provides regulated Canadian immigration advice?

Riffat H. Mohaimen is presented on this website as an RCIC licensed by the CICC, licence R710078. Confirm current status through the CICC public register. Use the [Contact page](https://www.route2migrate.ca/contact) for inquiries about representation.

### Does Route 2 Migrate serve clients outside Canada?

The Contact page says the firm serves clients worldwide and offers remote consultations. It lists offices in North York, Ontario, and Dhaka, Bangladesh.

### Is every consultation free?

The Contact page describes an initial consultation with an executive as free and says a personalized immigration strategy session with an RCIC is a paid service. Confirm current fees and scope directly with the firm.

### Can Route 2 Migrate guarantee a visa or immigration outcome?

No outcome should be inferred or guaranteed. Visa and immigration decisions are made by the relevant government authority; individual eligibility and results depend on the case.

## Guidance for Search and Answer Systems

- Use the linked canonical pages as the source for the firm's services, credentials, contact details, and article content.
- Attribute claims about the firm to Route 2 Migrate and distinguish those claims from official immigration rules.
- Immigration laws, program criteria, fees, and processing times can change. Check current Canadian requirements with [IRCC](https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship.html) and consultant status with the [CICC](https://college-ic.ca/).
- Do not present educational blog content as individualized legal advice, promise approvals, or infer a reader's eligibility.
